reading.title: Climate Change and Ocean Acidification
reading.passage: Ocean acidification is a critical consequence of climate change that threatens marine ecosystems worldwide. As atmospheric carbon dioxide levels rise, the ocean absorbs approximately 30% of these emissions, forming carbonic acid. This process lowers the pH of seawater, making it more acidic. The increased acidity interferes with the ability of mollusks, corals, and crustaceans to build their shells and skeletons. Scientists warn that if current emission rates continue, many marine species could face extinction by 2100, fundamentally disrupting food chains and affecting human food security.

questions.q: According to the passage, what percentage of atmospheric carbon dioxide does the ocean absorb?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'the ocean absorbs approximately 30% of these emissions'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as an effect of ocean acidification?
options: Interference with shell and skeleton formation
questions.explanation: 본문의 'The increased acidity interferes with the ability of mollusks, corals, and crustaceans to build their shells and skeletons'에서 답을 찾을 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What is the author's main concern about ocean acidification?
options: It causes ocean water to freeze
It may lead to extinction of marine species and threaten food security
It reduces the number of fishing boats
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 부분에서 저자는 해양 종의 멸종과 식량 안보 위협에 대해 경고하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: Technology has made people's lives easier but has negatively affected human relationships?

structure.intro: Opening sentence with clear position statement. Example: 'While technology has undoubtedly made our daily lives more convenient, I agree that it has significantly damaged face-to-face human relationships.' (2-3 sentences)
structure.body1: First supporting argument: Explain how technology reduces in-person interaction. Provide specific examples like social media replacing phone calls or instant messaging reducing conversations. (3-4 sentences)
structure.body2: Second supporting argument: Discuss how excessive screen time affects emotional connections and empathy development. Use relevant examples of family dynamics or workplace relationships. (3-4 sentences)
structure.conclusion: Restate your position and summarize main points. Suggest that balance between technology use and human connection is necessary. (2-3 sentences)

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study in quiet environments. Others prefer to study with background music or in busy cafes. Which do you prefer and why?
sample_points: 조용한 환경에서는 집중력이 높아져 복잡한 개념을 더 빠르게 이해할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 수학 문제나 외국어 학습 시 집중력이 필수적입니다.
조용한 환경은 스트레스를 줄이고 장시간 공부할 수 있게 해줍니다. 반면 시끄러운 환경은 학습 효율성을 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다.

listening.title: Professor's Lecture on Renewable Energy
listening.script: Good morning, everyone. Today I want to discuss renewable energy sources and their growing importance in addressing climate change. Solar and wind energy have become increasingly cost-effective over the past decade. Solar panels convert sunlight directly into electricity, while wind turbines harness kinetic energy from wind. However, both sources have limitations. Solar energy depends on weather conditions and daylight hours, making it less reliable in cloudy regions. Wind energy requires consistent wind patterns and is most effective in coastal or elevated areas. Despite these challenges, many countries are investing heavily in renewable infrastructure. Germany, for example, generates over 40% of its electricity from renewable sources. The transition to renewable energy requires not only technological advancement but also policy support and public investment. As fossil fuels become more expensive and environmental concerns grow, renewable energy will likely dominate the global energy market within the next 30 years.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the lecture?
options: Renewable energy sources and their development
questions.explanation: 교수는 재생 에너지원과 기후 변화 대응에서의 중요성에 대해 논의하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what is a limitation of solar energy?
options: It is too expensive to install
It is less reliable in cloudy regions due to dependence on daylight
It only works in coastal areas
questions.explanation: 강의에서 'Solar energy depends on weather conditions and daylight hours, making it less reliable in cloudy regions'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What percentage of electricity does Germany generate from renewable sources?
questions.explanation: 교수는 'Germany, for example, generates over 40% of its electricity from renewable sources'라고 언급했습니다.
